firm_data.firm_description: Habberfield Kaszycki LLP provides clients with a non-traditional approach to defending claims, offering personal attention to client matters. They handle cases throughout New York State and focus on relationships with clients to provide the best defense possible.
notable_facts: The firm has local offices in Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, and NYC.

email.subject: AI for Habberfield Kaszycki LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Melissa,

Your non-traditional approach to insurance defense and workers' compensation claims across New York State caught my attention. Since 2015, you've built something rare: a firm that competes on personal attention and client relationships rather than headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in upstate New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Buffalo office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
